fields.cover_headline: Someone just {o:vented} about the problem you {b:solve}.
fields.cover_sub: 3 moves to turn it into your next post.
fields.step1_body:
They named the pain.
In their own words.
No pitch in the way.
And you scrolled past it.
fields.step2_body:
Search X for the pain.
"so tired of" + your problem.
Tap Latest.
Now read what they say.
fields.step3_body:
Copy the line that stings most.
Keep their slang.
That's your next headline.
But don't pitch yet.
fields.step4_body:
Ask what they tried already.
They'll name what failed.
That's your competitor list.
And your next post.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment SIGNALS and I'll DM you the Buyer Signal Phrase List: the words buyers use before they pay.
